Abebook.title: Horace 2000: A Celebration: Essays for the Bimillennium
Abebook.subject: Horace; Quintus Horatius Flaccus; Latin poetry; Roman literature; classical studies; classics; Augustan Rome; Augustus; literary criticism; Niall Rudd; University of Michigan Press; first edition; illustrated
Abebook.description: First edition, first printing (number line 4 3 2 1) of this collection of seven essays on Horace marking the bimillennium of his death, edited by Niall Rudd, with contributions from Herbert Huxley, Jasper Griffin, Robin Seager, Denis Feeney, Oswyn Murray, Brian Arkins and Philip Hardie; illustrated with a section of black-and-white plates. Black cloth over boards with gilt spine lettering, in the original pictorial dust jacket, now in a mylar protector; the jacket is bright and unfaded with no chips or tears. A former academic library copy, plainly little used: call-number label to the spine, a blank label to the lower front cover, William F. Maag Library, Youngstown State University stamps to the front flyleaf, contents page and title page, a red WITHDRAWN stamp to the title page, the library name stamped on the top and fore edges of the text block, a barcode label and an unused date-due slip pasted to the rear pastedown, and yellowed tape residue at the endpapers where the jacket was secured. Apart from the library markings the book is excellent - boards square, binding tight, spine unfaded, pages bright and free of underlining or marginalia throughout - and the publisher's errata slip is still laid in at the front.
